blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Metro Manila and most of Luzon may experience generally fair weather on Tuesday, Nov. 24, according to the state weather bureau. In its 5 a.m. weather forecast, the Philippine Atmospheric, Geophysical, and AstronomicalServicesAdministration (Pagasa) said hot and humid conditions, with a chance of localized thunderstorms, may prevail over Metro Manila and parts of Luzon. “For Metro Manila and the rest of Luzon, inaasahan naman natin ang mainit at maalinsangan lalo na sa tanghali hanggang hapon na may mga posibilidad na mga localized thunderstorm lalo na po sa hapon at sa gabi,” Pagasa weather specialist Chenel Dominguez said.
